description: This source file implements the SessionServerManager class, which manages the lifecycle and state transitions of a session server in the Rialto media platform. It handles initialization, configuration, state changes (active, inactive, not running), logging levels, and communication with other services such as application management, session management, playback, and control services.

classes.name: SessionServerManager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle, configuration, and state transitions of a session server, coordinating between various services and handling logging and communication events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session server manager with command-line arguments, setting up application management server.

methods.name: startService
methods.description: Blocks until the service is stopped.

methods.name: stopService
methods.description: Stops the service and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with socket name, state, resource limits, display name, and permissions, then starts session management.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Changes the session server's state to active, inactive, or not running, handling necessary service calls and notifications.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets logging levels for various components and propagates to session management server.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings the control service with a given ID and acknowledgment sender.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Transitions the session server to active state, starting playback and cdm services, and notifying application management.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Transitions the session server to inactive state, stopping playback and cdm services, and notifying application management.

methods.name: switchToNotRunning
methods.description: Transitions the session server to not running state, stopping services and releasing resources.
